name: The water meadows

layers.essential_history: [[c:From the church side of the Old Bridge, a footpath leads through a gate and across the water meadows beside the Nene. It is the start of a favourite local walk along the river towards Yarwell.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Red kites are often seen over the river here. The meadows flood in wet winters, so expect mud and keep to the path.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:In the long grass you find a coachman's glove, soaked through. Someone came this way in the dark. (Long walk only.)]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Head north-east to the riverside, about 590 metres along the route. Follow the line on the map, and keep to pavements and public paths.]]
